about: The doc's 2026-27 candidate sectors, with 3-5 representative coins each (tickers from coins.csv) and the usage series that says whether the sector's fundamentals are growing. family links each sector to its past bursts in rotation.csv. Edit freely.
rules: Representatives' median RSI vs BTC at 70 or above, or up 50%+ against BTC over 90 days: stretched, the late stage of a burst.
Up 15%+ against BTC over 90 days and within 25% of the 1-year high: the rotation has already happened.
Usage up 10%+ over about 90 days while the coins are down 15%+ against BTC: fundamentals ahead of price.
60%+ below the 1-year high, no longer falling against BTC (90 days better than -15%), and usage not shrinking: washed out and basing, its turn not yet come.

usage.label: DeFi TVL, all chains (proxy for L1 activity)
